# ONLINE.UA

> > Ukrainian news and lifestyle portal covering politics, economy, automotive industry, celebrity news, and social issues with focus on Ukraine, Donbass, Crimea, and regional developments.

ONLINE.UA is a comprehensive Ukrainian media platform featuring expert blogs from analysts like Yaroslav Matyushin and Boris Kushniruk, alongside news coverage of international events, automotive industry updates, and lifestyle content. The site emphasizes Ukrainian perspectives on geopolitical issues, internal displacement, and cultural topics.

## Key Topics

- Україна (Ukraine)
- Донбасс (Donbass)
- Крым (Crimea)
- Ярослав Матюшин (analyst)
- ДНР (DNR)
- Курс долара (exchange rates)
- Переселенці (IDPs)
- Росія (Russia)
- Automotive news
- Geneva Motor Show
- Кейт Міддлтон (Kate Middleton)
- Healthy food
- Ukrainian cuisine
- Video blogs
- Fashion

- [Несовершенство законов в Украине бьет по переселенцам: яркие примеры](https://www.online.ua/blogs/krymskayadiaspora-nesoversenstvo-zakonov-v-ukraine-bet-po-pereselencam-iarkie-primery-152): Crimean Diaspora lawyer Hirenko on legal challenges for IDPs
